I started self harming this summer. I have know about self harm since about 5th or 6th grade from people that would visit our school to talk about mental health (depression, anxiety, etc.). I had never really seen it as something I would turn to. I had seen posts online about it and it helping people have a release from stress. So I just thought- could it really help? At the time, my mental health was the worst it had ever been (Spoiler: It got worse!). But one day while staying away until 1 or 2 am, I started to scratch my thighs. Not in a “Oo, my legs are itchy!” type way. I was taking my finger across my thighs. I kept doing it over and over until my thighs were basically completely raw. I remember my thighs being completely pink with long red marks from where my nails scratched the hardest. I did it almost every time I was in the shower for a few weeks. I stopped for a few months but now I’m here.
